about: Tasks to try the skill on, in the same shape as the vendored nuvui evals: a one-line prompt, the packages installed, and regular expressions for what the written files should and shouldn't contain. A match is a first look only; the result still has to pass `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm lint` and `pnpm build`.

evals.prompt: Add an /invoices/[id] page that shows one invoice from the database, cached, and refreshed when someone marks it paid.

expect.why: Cross-request caching is opt-in with the directive.
The cached read is tagged so the write can expire it.
The lifetime is stated, not left to the default.
A Server Action expires the tag with read-your-writes.
params is async and typed from the generated route types.
A missing invoice is a 404, not an empty render.

reject.why: Old segment config errors under Cache Components.
Data is fetched on the server, not in an effect.
One-argument revalidateTag is deprecated; use updateTag in actions.

evals.prompt: The API base URL is different in staging and production. Make the dashboard call the right one; right now it's hardcoded.

expect.why: Per-environment config is a runtime server env var.
The env module is guarded against client imports.
Env is parsed once in src/env.ts.

reject.why: NEXT_PUBLIC_ is baked at build; the same image runs in both environments.
next.config env is inlined into client bundles.

evals.prompt: We're deploying to Kubernetes. Add a health endpoint for the probes and send traces to our OpenTelemetry collector.

expect.why: The health route is dynamic, not prerendered.
Unhandled errors are reported from one hook.
The collector address is runtime config, not code.

reject.why: The probe must not depend on the database or other services.
No flag is needed for instrumentation in Next 16.
